confidence_notes: Broad Guadalajara price surveys support the meal, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors (about MX$250, MX$800, MX$69 and MX$50); October 2026 figures are a nearby proxy for July. Cocktail and wine are less directly measured, so they are estimated at roughly 3x and 2x the draft-beer price. Hostel estimates use ordinary-month prices, excluding the unusual June event spike. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Guadalajara-specific price data; no comparable city was needed.
